description: As a registered user, I want to edit my personal information on the profile page so that I can keep my account details up to date.

acs.text: The profile edit form displays fields for First Name, Last Name, Email, and Phone Number.
All fields are pre-filled with the current saved values when the form opens.
On Save, a success toast message 'Profile updated successfully' is shown for 3 seconds.
If the email is changed to one already in use, an error message 'Email already registered' is shown inline.
